root:
usage: marty-deploy.py [-h] [--repo-root REPO_ROOT]
                       {validate,plan,services,secrets,compose-command,bundle-assets}
                       ...

Inspect Marty deployment metadata without executing deployment commands.

positional arguments:
  {validate,plan,services,secrets,compose-command,bundle-assets}
    validate            Validate deployment catalogs, stacks, and bundle
                        manifests.
    plan                Render a redacted deployment plan for a stack.
    services            List service metadata from a stack or group.
    secrets             List required secret metadata for a stack.
    compose-command     Preview the docker compose command for a stack
                        operation.
    bundle-assets       List resolved asset paths for a bundle manifest.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo-root REPO_ROOT
                        Path to the marty-ui repository root.
validate:
usage: marty-deploy.py validate [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
plan:
usage: marty-deploy.py plan [-h] [--json] stack

positional arguments:
  stack       Stack profile name, for example selfhost-production.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      Emit JSON instead of text.
services:
usage: marty-deploy.py services [-h] [--group GROUP] [--running-only]
                                [--include-optional]
                                [--field {id,compose_service,k8s_deployment,image_name,service_name_env,group,lifecycle}]
                                [stack]

positional arguments:
  stack                 Stack profile name.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --group GROUP         Service group name to list instead of a stack.
  --running-only        Only include services with lifecycle=running when
                        listing a stack.
  --include-optional    Include stack optional services.
  --field {id,compose_service,k8s_deployment,image_name,service_name_env,group,lifecycle}
                        Service field to print.
secrets:
usage: marty-deploy.py secrets [-h]
                               [--field {id,env,file_env,compose_secret,no_log,allow_empty,required_for}]
                               stack

positional arguments:
  stack                 Stack profile name.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --field {id,env,file_env,compose_secret,no_log,allow_empty,required_for}
                        Secret field to print. Values are never resolved or
                        printed.
compose-command:
usage: marty-deploy.py compose-command [-h] [--json] stack operation

positional arguments:
  stack       Stack profile name.
  operation   Operation name from the stack manifest, such as config, up, ps,
              or logs.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      Emit JSON argv instead of shell-quoted text.
bundle-assets:
usage: marty-deploy.py bundle-assets [-h] bundle

positional arguments:
  bundle      Bundle manifest name, for example selfhost.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
